parts.label: (b)
(b)(i)
parts.text: Determine the acceleration of the rocket.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Show that the height of the rocket above the surface of the Earth at a time of $20\text{ s}$ after launch is $3.2\text{ km}$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.part_stem:
The mass of the rocket in (b) is $2.9 \times 10^6\text{ kg}$. Assume that this mass remains constant.

For this rocket, from launch to its height at a time of $20\text{ s}$ after launch:

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: calculate the gain in gravitational potential energy $\Delta E_{\text{P}}$

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: calculate the gain in kinetic energy $\Delta E_{\text{K}}$

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: determine the average power output of the rocket engines. Assume that resistive forces are negligible.
